title: LLM-Guided Evolution of Symbolic Acceleration Inequality Families for MILP
abstract: arXiv:2508.11850v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Integer programming (IP) is central to many combinatorial optimization tasks but remains challenging due to its NP-hard nature. A practical way to improve IP solvers is to manually design inequality families that exploit problem structure. However, this creative process requires deep expertise and has therefore been difficult to automate. Our proposed framework, Symbolic Acceleration via Generative Evolution (SAGE), automates symbolic discovery of acceleration inequality families at the modeling level. It reasons over a symbolic IP formulation and a natural language description of the problem to discover a reusable set of acceleration inequality families that can be instantiated for each problem instance. These acceleration inequality families are selected through empirical admissibility and impact screening rather than mathematical proofs. translated_title: 面向混合整数线性规划（MILP）的LLM引导符号加速不等式族演化
translated_abstract: 整数规划（IP）是许多组合优化任务的核心，但其NP难的本质使其依然充满挑战。改进IP求解器的一种实用途径是手动设计利用问题结构的不等式族，然而这一创造性过程需要深厚的专业知识，因此一直难以自动化。我们提出的框架——符号加速生成演化——在建模层面实现了加速不等式族的符号化自动发现。该框架通过对符号化的IP模型和问题的自然语言描述进行推理，发现一组可复用的加速不等式族，这些不等式族可以为每个具体问题实例进行实例化。这些加速不等式族是通过经验可行性与影响筛选来选择的，而非依赖数学证明。SAGE（i）通过初始……初始化候选加速不等式族种群（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出SAGE框架，利用大语言模型在符号层面自动发现并演化可复用的加速不等式族，用于加速混合整数线性规划求解，摆脱了对人工专家设计不等式的依赖。
en_tdlr: SAGE is an LLM-guided framework that automatically discovers and evolves reusable symbolic acceleration inequality families for MILP at the modeling level, eliminating the need for manual expert design.
